artifacts.title: Whether presbytery may investigate before proceeding to trial
artifacts.disposition: advice given — BCO 31-2 permits investigation before adjudication; amendments recommended

matches.evidence: BCO 31-2 permits a presbytery to investigate and determine strong presumption of guilt before adjudication; the CCB recommended amendments to BCO 31, 32, and 34 to clarify.

artifacts.title: Expedited, conflict-free investigations for cases with victims or moral failure

matches.evidence: The CCB found an overture to require expedited, conflict-free judicial investigations in BCO 31 to be in constitutional conflict, yet adopted it 8-0-0.
